real_union_tiles_set.note: This is the only real, currently-available candidate production training tile set on this machine. It does NOT currently contain a duplicate of the eval file -- the exact historical directory/state that produced the documented 2026-09-19 FAIL is confirmed absent from this checkout (consistent with the prior Codex finding), so there is no live leaking dataset here to physically purge. The fix below is verified against a deliberately reconstructed worst-case using these same real bytes.

reproduction_and_fix_verification.scenario: 8 real union_tiles + a literal byte-for-byte copy of the real eval file injected as a 9th 'tile' -- the exact content-identity-leak mechanism GAP-010 describes.

cli_entrypoints_wired.run_ksweep.py: manual_xodr/auto_xodr (the run's own eval pair) are ALWAYS excluded automatically; --exclude_source_xodr adds further protected paths; _list_tiles() filters the tile pool before nested_subsets() selection; the same exclusion set is forwarded to the train_map_encoder.py subprocess via --exclude_source_xodr and to _expected_manifest_for_subset() for checkpoint-identity parity.
cli_entrypoints_wired.live_smoke_test: run_ksweep.main() executed end-to-end (real subprocess training, K=3/4, real MapEncoder, real checkpoints) against a tiles_dir containing 5 real tiles + 1 injected literal copy of the eval file; ksweep_report.json confirmed the eval file's real SHA-256 in source_sha_exclusion_contract.excluded_hashes and the leak tile was dropped before any K subset was formed.
